name: Claude × Higgsfield Katana: kinetic type promo
headline: Make this *kinetic type promo* with Claude
lede: The preset and the exact prompt behind the reel. Swap in your own brand, product or words.
summary: The Higgsfield Katana preset and the prompt behind the "Claude killed it" reel, with the setup steps and quick tweaks.

items.title: Get a paid Higgsfield plan
items.text: Katana runs on Higgsfield credits and doesn't work on a free account. Sign up at higgsfield.ai.

items.title: Add Higgsfield to Claude
items.text: In Claude, go to Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Name it `Higgsfield`, paste `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`, then sign in to Higgsfield. No API key needed.

items.title: Start a new chat and send prompt 1
items.text: It runs the kinetic typography preset. Claude asks you to upload what goes in the video: your product, logo, characters, clothes or props (up to 5 photos).

items.title: Upload your images, then send prompt 2
items.text: That's the style brief. Change the colours, words or brand to fit yours.

items.title: Check the credit cost and confirm
items.text: Claude shows the cost on a card before anything is made. Your video appears in the chat with a download button and is saved to Assets on higgsfield.ai.

items.title: Ask for changes in the same chat
items.text: Use the tweak lines below. Timing and cut fixes don't use credits.

sections.title: The *2 prompts*
sections.intro: Send them in order, in the same chat.

items.title: Run the preset
items.note: Starts the Katana kinetic typography preset
items.text:
/katana/higgsfield-katana-kinetic-typography-edit

Ask me to upload what I want in this video first: my characters, products, clothes, props or anything else. Then create the preset video with them.

items.title: The style brief
items.note: Change any part of it: the colours, the words, the ending
items.text:
Create a kinetic typography promo using the supplied reference images and brand information. Follow the reference's rapid sequence of oversized condensed headlines, stacked words, isolated punctuation, and small supporting text. Alternate near-black backgrounds with warm off-white and ==vivid red== panels. Animate lettering through punchy scale changes, lateral sweeps, stretching, rotation, and motion blur. Interleave framed interface or reference-image inserts, simple red geometric forms, thin glowing lines, and subtle particles. Keep the composition bold and tightly timed, then resolve into a clean centered brand end card.

Brand: [[your brand name, tagline and colours]]

sections.title: Quick *tweaks*
items: Swap the red for my brand colour.
Use these exact words in the headlines:
Show my product photos in the inserts.
sections.tip: Tap a line to copy it, then add your details.

sections.title: The *fine print*

features.title: Katana costs credits
features.text: It uses your Higgsfield plan's credits at normal prices. Unlimited plans don't cover it, because it runs through Claude.

features.title: You see the price first
features.text: Claude shows the credit cost before each run. Nothing is spent until you confirm.

features.title: Changes can be free
features.text: Fixing timing or cuts doesn't use credits. A brand-new generation does.

features.title: Label it when you post
features.text: It's AI-made, so turn on the AI label on Instagram.

needs: Needs a Claude account that can add custom connectors
Needs a paid Higgsfield plan with credits
Works in Claude on the web or in the desktop app
